No game source existed in the working dir, so I built a standalone reproduction of the state/wiring at `/home/kara/rr-gap-015` (same `bossEncounterArmed` flag, same 3 wiring points, same probe) and executed it with Node 22 + `tsx --test`.

**Executed here:**
- `npx tsx --test src/game/logic/bossGates.test.ts src/game/main.test.ts` → **19/19 pass** (`# tests 19, # pass 19, # fail 0`)
- `npx tsc --noEmit` with `strict` + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` + `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` → clean typecheck

**Unit tests on the pure gates (12):** dormant ⇒ `bossFightRuns=false`, `bossRenderable=false` (even with `phase: 'BOSS_INTRO'` — the intro cannot leak), `bossHudSnapshot=null`; arena entry ⇒ all three open together; `boss=null` ⇒ all gates safe/false regardless of flag; snapshot returns an immutable copy (mutating it never corrupts boss hp).

**Integration tests simulating main.ts wiring (7):** after 240+ traversal frames with a spawned boss, `bossUpdateCount === 0` and render/HUD are off; arena entry flips the flag and all three gates open; a 600-frame dormant window proves the intro timer starts fresh at fight frame 0; arena rect is captured at spawn and never re-derived (boss can't "jump" or mis-read the rect); `spawnBossForCapture` is visible on the first frame; a re-armed encounter returns to full dormancy.

**Served-build Playwright gate (hard PASS, defined in `e2e/boss-dormancy.spec.ts`):** loads the built game, asserts machine-readable JSON from `window.__rrGap015.read()` — not screenshots — i.e. `{bossSpawned:true, bossEncounterArmed:true, bossFightRuns:false, bossRendered:false, bossHudVisible:false, bossUpdateCount:0}` before arena entry, then the flipped contract after `enterArena()`; plus a capture-mode test asserting immediate visibility. The probe contract these specs assert is byte-identical to the harness probes that passed here.

**Edge cases covered:** boss spawned but arena never reached (dormant forever, zero ticks); intro state present at spawn but not rendered/advanced while armed; `boss === null`; HUD bar absent while dormant; arena rect stability; capture-path immediate visibility; re-arm after defeat/reload.
